wording_rules.W1: no window is 'the right one'. This arm reports STABILITY across windows. If one window is more favourable to any claim in this paper, that window may not be adopted and the full-window result stays the reported one.
wording_rules.W2: if a headline sign flips at any window, the manuscript states the claim as window-dependent. The window is not discarded and the claim is not quietly narrowed.
wording_rules.W3: a high correlation between local and global rescue does not establish that the outcome is local. It establishes that this corpus's distal changes do not dominate the ranking, which is the weaker statement the paper may make.

not_a_test: This run introduces no new predictor, no new corpus and no new outcome definition. It varies one set of positions inside a formula the corpus already released.

declaration_erratum: The declaration's V2 assumed every mutation-tagged double mutant carries a mutation. 74 carry a null substitution (A40A) and have the wild type's design-region sequence. V2 fired at 1.5785% against its 1% kill, the cause was diagnosed rather than the threshold relaxed, and those records are excluded before the check as out of its scope -- they contain no intervention to centre a window on, and Definition 1 had already refused all 74. The declaration is not edited.
